scale: Score each criterion 0–2: 0 unacceptable, 1 flawed, 2 acceptable.

criteria.content_match: 0 wrong subject; 1 partly matches; 2 clearly matches prompt
criteria.artifacts: 0 severe artifacts; 1 visible but tolerable flaws; 2 no obvious distracting artifacts
criteria.detail_usability: 0 unusable detail; 1 usable with substantial limitations; 2 sufficiently clear and coherent

threshold: Each criterion >= 1 and total >= 5 for each image; assess baseline and candidate on validation seeds blind to arm. Record individual scores and reviewer identity as an anonymized logical alias.
review: Independent blinded human review; absent human review label automated proxy / pending human confirmation, never claim equivalent quality.
